Derivative-Free Optimization 11: The Black-Box MADS Minimisers¶

Chapter 4 used the black-box interface through the facade. Called directly, mads_blackbox_minimizer, orthomads_blackbox_minimizer and ltmads_blackbox_minimizer expose every setting: how several objectives are combined, how violations are priced, what counts against the budget, the cache, the surrogate and the Pareto archive. After this chapter you can set each deliberately and read everything the outcome reports.

Every program is complete and its output is the output of that program. Counts are evaluations of the objective.

The calls¶

BlackboxAdvancedOutcome mads_blackbox_minimizer(blackbox, initial, MadsBlackboxAdvancedConfig config = {});
BlackboxAdvancedOutcome orthomads_blackbox_minimizer(blackbox, initial, MadsBlackboxAdvancedConfig config = {});
BlackboxAdvancedOutcome ltmads_blackbox_minimizer(blackbox, initial, MadsBlackboxAdvancedConfig config = {});

blackbox is a function from a point to a BlackboxEvaluation (objectives, constraints, evaluation_ok, count_evaluation; see Chapter 4). The three entry points differ only in the poll scheme. MadsBlackboxAdvancedConfig extends the scalar MadsBlackboxConfig of Chapter 10 (frame and mesh settings, budgets, bounds, search_points, window test) with:

Field

Meaning

Default

constraint_handling, constraint_tolerance, progressive_barrier_penalty

Ignore, ExtremeBarrier or ProgressiveBarrier; a violation up to the tolerance counts as feasible; penalty per unit of violation

Ignore, 1e-12, 100

multiobjective_scalarization, objective_weights, objective_reference

WeightedSum or Chebyshev; weights and Chebyshev reference point

WeightedSum, 1/m each for m objectives, zeros

enable_cache, cache_max_entries, cache_round_digits

cache of evaluated points, its size, and the rounding that decides two points are the same

on, 200000, 12

count_cache_hits_in_total_evaluations, max_total_evaluations

whether repeats count toward the total, and the total cap (0 means four times max_evaluations)

true, 0

surrogate_mode, surrogate_min_points, surrogate_max_points, surrogate_bandwidth

Off or CandidateOrdering; model size and smoothing

Off, 24, 512, 0 (automatic)

pareto_epsilon, pareto_archive_limit

tolerance for domination; archive size

1e-12, 256

accelerate_heavy_kernels, auto_heavy_platform, heavy_platform, heavy_dtype

where the model computations run

on, on, CPU, Float32

BlackboxAdvancedOutcome holds minimizer, objective_vector (all objectives at the minimiser), scalarized_minimum, status, pareto_points, pareto_objectives, and diagnostics: iterations, evaluations, total_evaluations, cache_hits, surrogate_orderings, pareto_size, objective_dimension, constraint_dimension, last_phase, mesh_size, frame_size. The facade’s DfoOptions::mads is the same MadsBlackboxAdvancedConfig.

Programs¶

  • The black-box MADS minimisers

Checklist¶

  1. Report failures with evaluation_ok, cheap checks with count_evaluation = false.

  2. Choose the scalarization to match the front: weighted sum for convex, Chebyshev otherwise.

  3. Turn the surrogate on when evaluations are expensive and the function is smooth.

  4. Keep the cache on for deterministic functions.

  5. Set max_total_evaluations when the free calls could add up.

  6. Check feasibility at the returned point yourself.
